todos: [P2] FULLTASK-RELIABILITY-01: FULLTASK-BEHAVIORAL-CLOSURE-01 is closed (2026-09-24): scripts/live/fullTaskRun.live.ts with qwen2.5-coder:7b reached completionStatus 'verified' in runs 15, 17 and 22 (8/8 in 28 and 34 steps, build first, then npm test). The closure is not yet reliable: of runs 17-26 after the fixes, 2 closed verified. Remaining failure classes, each seen once: run 24 the model called ask about dependency versions and AUTO mode ended the run (the application could answer it: use the published versions); run 26 Vitest 0.26 (pinned by the model) printed only chai's one-line message with a truncated received value (fixed 2026-09-24: expected/received are read from that message and the rewrite falls back to literal JSX text of the module the test imports, testedModuleText; not yet rerun); run 25 a CssSyntaxError under [plugin vite:css] (now diagnosed, not yet rerun); run 21 the model kept @import 'tailwindcss/tailwind.min.css' against the removal directive while the auto-matched tailwind-css-v4 skill told it Tailwind v4 syntax for a project declaring tailwindcss ^3 (fixed 2026-09-24: skills named <package>-v<major> leave the prompt and the adherence check once the manifest declares another major, skillVersionFit.ts; not yet rerun). Next, answer version questions in AUTO from registry facts instead of ending the run, then rerun until at least 3 of 5 runs close verified.

[P2] GPTOSS-FULLTASK-01: gpt-oss:20b plans and runs the full task (GPTOSS-PLAN-JSON-01 fixed: structured requests of level-only models send think 'low') but still ends 0/10. Fixed on 2026-09-24: shell reads (sed -n, cat, type, Get-Content, shasum on one workspace file) run as read_file (shellFileRead.ts), the executor accepts the substituted read_file, every turn exposing run_command also exposes read_file (run 4 lost 8 of 41 steps to read_file denials), and skills named <package>-v<major> leave the prompt and the adherence check once the manifest declares another major (run 4: tailwind-css-v4 made the adherence check refuse '@tailwind base;' in a tailwindcss ^3 project, so the build could not pass). Open: run 5 (after those fixes) stopped at step 15 on the execution recovery budget: read_file on files not yet written (src/main.jsx, index.css) and on the directory 'src' each count as execution failures, and 2 of them end the run (recoveryBudget.ts, MAX_FAILURES_PER_RECOVERY_CATEGORY). The model also re-reads every file right after writing it (steps 2, 5, 9, 12). Run 4 ended at step 41 on 'Ollama chat stream stalled: no tokens received for 30s' twice, while the fast test suite was running on the same machine; not seen on an idle machine yet. Next, report a read of a missing path as a result (with the parent directory listing) instead of an execution failure, run a read_file on a directory as list_dir, then rerun with ONLYRAG_LIVE_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b on an idle machine.

[P3] EXPLICIT-ANY-BACKLOG-01: since 2026-09-24 noExplicitAny is an error in every non-test file (biome.json override over electron/, shared/, src/ and scripts/; untrusted JSON boundaries use the documented UntrustedJson alias in shared/types, sessionHistoryDomain normalizers use unknown plus narrowing). npx biome lint still lists 134 warnings, all in test doubles: 118 in electron/ (agentOrchestratorToolGates.test.ts 15, toolSchemaValidator.test.ts 14, processToolService.test.ts 12, sidecarAppService.test.ts 9, agentIpc.test.ts 7 lead) and 16 in src/ (soundEffectsService.test.ts 8, i18n.test.ts 3). Next, replace the `as any` casts with typed doubles (`as unknown as T` or builder helpers) module by module, then drop the test exclusion from the override.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: the untitled sentinels are gone (2026-09-24): coding sessions and chat conversations store '' and the renderer shows the localized default, legacy 'Nuova Sessione'/'New Session'/'Nuova Conversazione'/'New Chat' titles read as untitled. Text produced in Main still reaches the UI in Italian only: about 70 agent timeline emitLog messages and the closure summaries (agentOrchestratorApplicationClosure.ts 'Esito applicativo', 'NON VERIFICABILE'/'BLOCCATO', agentOrchestratorToolResultProcessor.ts, agentOrchestratorCircuitBreakerAndVerification.ts), Main error strings such as sidecarAppService.ts 'ID documento non valido.' and sidecarHttpClient.ts 'Eliminazione scaduta...'; the Sidecar chunk prefix '[Documento: … | Sezione: …]' is embedded in stored vectors. Next, give AgentLogEntry an optional message code plus params that the renderer translates (the Italian text stays as fallback and for the model), migrate the closure summary first, and leave the chunk prefix until a re-index migration exists.

[P3] LIVE-AUDIT-REDACTION-01: the coding agent audit log (sanitizeLogMessage in electron/logRedactor.ts, EXCEPTION_DETAIL_PATTERN) replaces the rest of every line containing error/failed/unable followed by ':' with '[details redacted]', which in live snapshots hides the runner messages (ReferenceError text, Vitest/Vite error lines) and even the label 'Last useful error:' itself; the analysis of full task runs 12-26 had to infer causes from code frames. Next, let the live harness (scripts/live/agentLiveHarness.ts) keep an unredacted copy of tool outputs inside %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live for local runs only, leaving the persisted app logs redacted.
